items.q: Gross rating point may be defined as
o: a short paid notice grouped with similar items under a heading in a newspaper
a measure found by multiplying the percentage reached by the average number of exposures
promotion aimed at firms that buy machinery, components or supplies for their own operations
the trial of draft material on a sample of the audience before release
items.s: Gross rating point: a measure found by multiplying the percentage reached by the average number of exposures. The other options describe Copy testing, Classified advertisement, Industrial advertising.

harmless exaggeration that no reasonable buyer would take as fact
items.s: Advertising medium: any vehicle such as a newspaper, billboard or station slot that carries a commercial message to an audience. The other options describe Puffery, Advertising agency, Storyboard.
